subject: Context Horizon — upfront allowance request for large-context POC
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@contexthorizon.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Context Horizon Procurement <procurement@contexthorizon.ai>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC scope — request for higher starter credits (large context / high TPM)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We want to move quickly with a 6-week POC to validate multi-document search + long-form synthesis over 1M tokens of internal docs. Two things that will drive usage:

- Average context window will be ~150k tokens per session (we'll stream chunks to the model).
- Expected concurrency during ingest/testing is 15+ TPM (higher than a typical trial).

Our team will need an expanded starter allowance so we can run real ingest + evals without being throttled. Can Redwood provide an upfront trial credit top-up and a short trial extension (30 days) tied to the POC? I attached a short requirements PDF with the planned cadence.

If useful, procurement can sign a POC statement of work — we just need to avoid early throttling.

Regards,
Samir Patel
Director of ML, Context Horizon
procurement@contexthorizon.ai

Attachment: context-horizon-poc-requirements.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@contexthorizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope — request for higher starter credits (large context / high TPM)

Samir — appreciate the clear plan and the attachment. Short answer: we can usually accommodate larger context POCs, but I need a quick internal sign-off for an upfront allowance and the 30-day extension.

I'll loop in Marissa (CS lead) to confirm onboarding support and Priyom (solutions) to double-check token & batching recommendations so we don't waste the grant on suboptimal settings. Can you confirm the rough token burn estimate per day and whether you need dedicated capacity or hosted? That will affect the size of the allowance.

Goal: surface a proposed uplift today so you can proceed.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: POC scope — request for higher starter credits (internal)

Karthik / Rishi — forwarding Samir's note. Quick notes from our side:

- CS can provide 2 onboarding sessions (2 hrs each) + a day of workshop time.
- For 150k context work, recommend a hybrid approach: prefix caching + chunking at 32k windows with overlap to preserve coherence. That should cut token burn by ~30% compared to naive full-window runs.
- If they're hosted and not dedicated, we'll need to be conservative with concurrency allowances.

Proposal for approval: grant an upfront hosted trial credit of $12,000 and extend trial window by 30 days. If they commit to a Dedicated PoC (reserved pool) within 45 days, convert $8k of that grant into a bridge credit toward the reserved commit.

Attachments: redwood-proposal-v1.2.docx (proposal + suggested runbook)

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC scope — request for higher starter credits (approval)

Thanks for the summary. Approve the uplift with one ask: include a lightweight mutual action plan and a KPIs clause — specifically:

- Define 3 evaluation checkpoints (week 2, week 4, week 6) with clear success metrics (f1/precision on retrieval QA, latency SLO under 800ms for S1 flows).
- If they don't hit the week-4 baseline, we reserve the right to throttle further grants.

I'll authorize the $12,000 hosted credit + 30 day extension. Karthik, please confirm and issue the credit with the MAP and account tag CH-4521 so billing recognizes the POC. Priyom, please prepare the short runbook to minimize token waste.

-Rishi
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@contexthorizon.ai>, Context Horizon Procurement <procurement@contexthorizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T15:27:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: $12,000 upfront trial credit + 30 day extension (Context Horizon CH-4521)

Samir — good news: Rishi has approved an upfront hosted trial credit of $12,000 and we've extended your trial window by 30 days. Details and next steps below.

1) Credit issuance: $12,000 credit applied to your account (tag CH-4521). This is hosted-only and will not cover Dedicated reserved pool costs.
2) Trial extension: +30 days from your current expiration date (system will show updated expiry).
3) Conditions & MAP: we attached a short mutual action plan (week 2/4/6 checkpoints) and the success metrics. If baseline metrics at week 4 are not met, we may pause further grant funding until we troubleshoot.
4) Onboarding & runbook: Marissa will schedule the two onboarding sessions; Priyom will send the runbook with batching/cache recommendations to reduce token burn.

Attachment: redwood-proposal-v1.2.docx (proposal + MAP)

Samir, please confirm receipt and that procurement has what they need to sign a POC SOW if desired. We'll leave $8,000 of the credit earmarked for conversion to a Dedicated commit credit should you decide to go that route within 45 days.

Thanks — excited to see the results.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
